taskPurpose.exactNormativeText: A machine-readable requirement manifest is generated from this PRD and is the release-blocking source for every requirement, acceptance criterion, invariant, ADR, dependency group, implementation owner, schema, test, surface, telemetry, and activation/rollback mapping.

Requirement, acceptance, invariant, ADR, feature, schema, API, tool, policy, artifact, and test IDs are globally unique, stable, immutable once released, and replaced only through explicit deprecation/supersession links.

CI fails when a normative item lacks implementation/test/owner mapping, a mapped code path no longer exists, a requirement is implemented outside its dependency gate, or generated documentation differs from the manifest.
Manual, legal, rights, statistical, and owner-approval gates produce signed/hashed evidence artifacts with approver, scope, expiration, and revocation semantics rather than unchecked booleans.
Every production decision and alert stores the exact requirement/policy/feature/model/tool/provider/adapter/artifact versions and test/conformance release that authorized its behavior.
Release reports include document hash, manifest hash, migration/schema hashes, dependency/SBOM hash, conformance results, unresolved deviations, activation state, and rollback target.
